t.why: It has Rotterdam, Europe's largest port, and ASML, the chip lithography company that holds a key to the technology race.
t.rel: A trading nation with Rotterdam, Europe's largest port. Home to the chip-equipment company ASML, it holds a key to export controls in the US-China technology race.
t.korea: It fought in the Korean War. Koreans know it well from coach Guus Hiddink and the 2002 World Cup, and trade in chip equipment is large.
t.know: With about a quarter of the land below sea level, the Dutch have lived by building dikes and pumping out water.
t.etext: Europe's logistics gateway, centered on the port of Rotterdam. It is home to the company with a monopoly on chip lithography machines, and its exports of flowers, vegetables and other farm products rank among the world's highest.
